name: setup
description: Setup skills: sets up a project to use these skills (starter profiles, a section in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, optional guardrails with a hook that refuses shell writes to protected paths), and keeps a Claude Code setup current by watching trusted sources for new practices, recommending them and codifying the ones adopted, and turns recurring tasks into headless jobs (a cheap guard, scoped tools, a spend cap and a schedule) instead of session crons.
